/presentation.en: A 28-year-old man is brought from work after becoming confused and having difficulty answering simple questions.
/presentation.es: Un hombre de 28 años es traído desde su trabajo tras quedar confundido y con dificultad para responder preguntas simples.

/history_source.es: Compañero de trabajo e información de emergencia sobre medicamentos

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: His coworker reports sudden confusion and difficulty finding words.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Su compañero de trabajo refiere que de repente quedó confundido y con dificultad para encontrar las palabras.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: His coworker noticed shaking and sweating before he became confused.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: Su compañero de trabajo notó que temblaba y sudaba antes de quedar confundido.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: There was no witnessed seizure, fall or head injury.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: No se presenció ninguna convulsión, caída ni golpe en la cabeza.

/history/medical_history/0.en: His coworker reports type 1 diabetes; his emergency information confirms this.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Su compañero de trabajo refiere que tiene diabetes tipo 1; su información de emergencia lo confirma.

/history/medications/0.en: His medication record lists basal and mealtime insulin.
/history/medications/0.es: Su registro de medicamentos incluye insulina basal y prandial.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: He was well at the start of work and became confused over the last 20 minutes.
/history/onset/0.es: Estaba bien al comienzo de la jornada y quedó confundido en los últimos 20 minutos.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: His coworker reports that he took his usual mealtime insulin but was called away before eating lunch.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Su compañero de trabajo refiere que se puso su insulina prandial habitual, pero lo llamaron y tuvo que irse antes de almorzar.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: His lunch was left uneaten after he took his mealtime insulin.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Su almuerzo quedó sin comer después de que se puso la insulina prandial.

/history/exposure/0.en: His coworker reports no known alcohol or sedative exposure during the shift.
/history/exposure/0.es: Su compañero de trabajo no refiere exposición conocida a alcohol ni a sedantes durante el turno.

/history/neurological_symptoms/0.en: He became confused and had difficulty speaking; no one saw a persistent one-sided weakness.
/history/neurological_symptoms/0.es: Quedó confundido y le costaba hablar; nadie vio una debilidad persistente de un lado del cuerpo.

/examination/Cardiac.en: Regular tachycardia with palpable peripheral pulses.
/examination/Cardiac.es: Taquicardia regular con pulsos periféricos palpables.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Normal effort; clear bilateral breath sounds.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Esfuerzo respiratorio normal; murmullo pulmonar bilateral sin ruidos agregados.

/examination/Neurological.en: Drowsy and confused, but opens eyes to voice; speech is slow and all limbs move symmetrically. Pupils are equal and reactive.
/examination/Neurological.es: Somnoliento y confuso, pero abre los ojos a la voz; habla lentamente y moviliza las cuatro extremidades en forma simétrica. Pupilas isocóricas y reactivas.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Sin líneas B; patrón de líneas A bilateral

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.

/presentation.en: A 76-year-old woman is brought by her son because she has become difficult to wake this morning.
/presentation.es: Una mujer de 76 años es traída por su hijo porque esta mañana está difícil de despertar.

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: Her son reports that she has become unusually difficult to wake.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Su hijo refiere que está más difícil de despertar que de costumbre.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: Her son noticed sweating and reduced interaction.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: Su hijo notó que sudaba y que interactuaba menos.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: There was no witnessed seizure or head injury.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: No se presenció ninguna convulsión ni golpe en la cabeza.

/history/medical_history/0.en: Her son reports type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease; she is normally alert and independent at home.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Su hijo refiere que tiene diabetes tipo 2 y enfermedad renal crónica; habitualmente está alerta y es independiente en su casa.

/history/medications/0.en: Her medication list includes glimepiride; she continued taking it despite eating very little.
/history/medications/0.es: Su lista de medicamentos incluye glimepirida; siguió tomándola pese a que comía muy poco.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: Her intake has been poor for two days; she was markedly less responsive this morning.
/history/onset/0.es: Su ingesta ha sido escasa durante dos días; esta mañana estaba marcadamente menos reactiva.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: She has continued a sulfonylurea during poor intake and has impaired renal function.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Ha seguido tomando una sulfonilurea mientras su ingesta era escasa y tiene la función renal alterada.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: Her son reports that she has eaten little for two days but continued her usual tablets.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Su hijo refiere que lleva dos días comiendo poco, pero siguió tomando sus pastillas habituales.

/history/exposure/0.en: Her son reports no new sedatives or known alcohol ingestion.
/history/exposure/0.es: Su hijo no refiere sedantes nuevos ni ingesta conocida de alcohol.

/history/neurological_symptoms/0.en: Her son describes a generalized reduction in responsiveness rather than a witnessed focal weakness.
/history/neurological_symptoms/0.es: Su hijo describe una disminución generalizada de la reactividad en lugar de una debilidad focal presenciada.

/examination/Cardiac.en: Regular pulse with preserved peripheral volume.
/examination/Cardiac.es: Pulso regular, con pulsos periféricos de amplitud conservada.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Normal effort and clear bilateral breath sounds.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Esfuerzo respiratorio normal y murmullo pulmonar bilateral sin ruidos agregados.

/examination/Abdomen.es: Blando, sin dolor focal a la palpación.

/examination/Neurological.en: Opens eyes only briefly to a firm stimulus and localizes with both arms. Pupils are equal and reactive.
/examination/Neurological.es: Abre los ojos solo brevemente ante un estímulo firme y localiza con ambos brazos. Pupilas isocóricas y reactivas.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Sin líneas B; patrón de líneas A bilateral

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.

/presentation.en: A 54-year-old man is brought from a shelter after being found drowsy and unsteady. He has eaten almost nothing for days.
/presentation.es: Un hombre de 54 años es traído desde un albergue tras ser encontrado somnoliento e inestable. Lleva días sin comer casi nada.

/history_source.en: Shelter staff and the paramedic record
/history_source.es: Personal del albergue y registro de los paramédicos

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: His speech is muddled and he says he feels shaky.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Habla de forma confusa y dice que se siente tembloroso.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: He has been unsteady on his feet.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: He has had no fever, cough or vomiting.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: No ha tenido fiebre, tos ni vómitos.

/history/medical_history/0.en: He drinks heavily every day and has eaten very little for a week; he is not diabetic.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Bebe mucho alcohol todos los días y lleva una semana comiendo muy poco; no es diabético.

/history/medications/0.en: He takes no regular medicines and has received no vitamins.
/history/medications/0.es: No toma medicamentos de uso habitual y no ha recibido vitaminas.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: The confusion and unsteadiness came on through this morning.
/history/onset/0.es: La confusión y la inestabilidad fueron apareciendo durante esta mañana.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: He drinks heavily and has eaten almost nothing for days.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Bebe mucho alcohol y lleva días sin comer casi nada.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: He has had almost nothing to eat for about a week, and alcohol most days.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Lleva alrededor de una semana sin comer casi nada, y ha bebido alcohol casi todos los días.

/history/neurological_symptoms/0.en: His walking has been unsteady and he says his vision feels unfocused.
/history/neurological_symptoms/0.es: Ha caminado de forma inestable y dice que siente la vista desenfocada.

/examination/Cardiac.en: Regular mildly rapid pulse; no murmur.
/examination/Cardiac.es: Pulso regular y levemente rápido; sin soplos.

/examination/Respiratory.es: Esfuerzo respiratorio normal; murmullo pulmonar sin ruidos agregados.

/examination/Abdomen.es: Blando, sin dolor a la palpación ni visceromegalias.

/examination/Neurological.en: Drowsy but rousable; gaze is unsteady with a few beats of nystagmus, and gait could not be tested safely. Pupils are equal and reactive.
/examination/Neurological.es: Somnoliento pero despertable; mirada inestable con algunas sacudidas de nistagmo, y no fue posible evaluar la marcha de forma segura. Pupilas isocóricas y reactivas.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Sin líneas B; patrón de líneas A bilateral

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.
